column1: //step Guided tours | | A guided tour moves through a model one step at a time. This page explains how to write one. Its own tour lines are at the bottom of the text box.

//step Tour lines | Tour lines | A tour is written as extra comment lines in the model. A "double slash" //tour line gives the title. Each "double slash" //step line gives a title and some names and a caption separated by vertical bars.
//step Steps | Steps | The names in a step are node texts separated by semicolons. A subgraph title lights the whole box. A step with no names shows the whole model.
//step Parts of a step | Parts of a step | A "double slash" //sub line adds a part to the step above it. A part zooms in on some of the step's nodes and keeps the same highlighting.
//sub An example | A part ; The step line above it ; Some of the step's nodes ; The step's highlighting | This is a part. It zooms in on four nodes of this box.
//step The tour controls | The tour controls | Use Back and Play and Forward to move through the tour. Moving the model while it plays pauses it until you press Resume.
//sub Keys | The tour panel ; Shift with Back or Forward ; A whole step | The arrow keys move back and forward. Space plays or pauses. C re-centres and H hides the controls.

//step Tips for writing tours | Tips for writing tours | Keep each caption to three commas or fewer. Write the words "double slash" before // so that it is read aloud. The browser console notes steps whose text is too small.
